[Textbook answer-key error: the printed key gives the units as \(\Omega/\text{m}\) and \(\text{m}/\Omega\). Both VALUES are correct, and both units are not. Resistivity is \(\rho = RA/L\), which carries \(\Omega\,\text{m}\); conductivity is its reciprocal, \((\Omega\,\text{m})^{-1}\). As printed the quantities are dimensionally not a resistivity and a conductivity at all.]

[Textbook answer-key error: two of the five printed values are wrong, and one mistake explains both. Item 3, **Red Red Orange Gold**, is \(22 \times 10^{3} = 22\ \text{k}\Omega \pm 5\%\); the key prints \(2.2\ \text{k}\Omega\). Item 5, **Yellow Violet Brown Silver**, is \(47 \times 10^{1} = 470\ \Omega \pm 10\%\); the key prints \(4.70\ \text{k}\Omega\). The three items the key gets right — 1, 2 and 4 — all happen to carry a RED third band, whose multiplier is \(\times 10^{2}\); substituting \(\times 10^{2}\) into items 3 and 5 reproduces the printed answers exactly. The key-setter applied the Red multiplier to all five and ignored the actual third band twice. Read against the chapter's own colour table, Orange is \(\times 10^{3}\) and Brown is \(\times 10^{1}\).]

[Textbook misprint: the parenthetical reads "1.0 Kwh = 1 unit of **power**". A kilowatt-hour is a unit of ENERGY, not power — power is the kilowatt. The example refutes itself two lines later, closing with "6.9 units of electrical **energy**". The arithmetic and the answer are unaffected.]

[Textbook misprint: the book's printed line for \(V_{BC}\) is wrong three ways at once — it states the relation as \(I \times 1\), then substitutes \(2.1 \times 2.1\), and prints a result of \(2\) V that matches NEITHER reading (\(2.1 \times 2.1 = 4.41\); \(2.1 \times 1 = 2.1\)). The correct value is \(2.1\) V, which is what this example's OWN closing Note uses. Separately, the stem asks for \(V_{AB}\), \(V_{BC}\) and \(V_{DC}\), but the printed working never derives \(V_{AB}\) — while the same Note quotes \(4.2\) V for it. The derivation above has been corrected and the missing \(V_{AB} = I \times R_{AB} = 2.1 \times 2 = 4.2\) V supplied.]
